Data

library(tidyverse)
figure3 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/master/Downloads/Bren/MEDS Summer/eds214/MAH214final/output/clean_data.csv"
)



Methods
Text can go here!


Results

ggplot(
  data = figure3,
  mapping = aes(
    x = Sample_Date,
    y = concentration,
    linetype = site
  )
) +
  ggtitle(
    "Hurricane effect on stream chemistry"
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = ymd("1989-09-18"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Years",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ion, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() # remove minor grid lines
  )
